contributions.statement: Start agent rollout on declarative, additive, well-scoped tasks (docs, config, tests) before context-heavy ones such as template or function implementation.
contributions.evidence: §4.2: BERTopic categories with descriptive merge ratios, no statistical tests or repo controls; merge rate is a contested proxy (2605.22534); Python only.
relative_to: agents succeed on narrow, well-specified tasks

reason: Descriptive merge-rate differences on Python repos with a proxy the KB already shows is misleading; the defect-proneness claim is weak and right-censored. Nothing actionable beyond common practice.
